answer: A fraud bounty stops fakes: each identity anchors one orchard plot on a 70-credit bond. The trellis lists each plot's work; anyone may post a fraud proof; a proven fake loses its bond, 40% to the challenger. First filing costs 45, the kth 45+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Self-challenge fails: across the orchard, your own fake returns only 40% while 60% burns. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its bond.
